context: Tests whether the agent includes a mandatory Implementation Plan section when documenting a code-impacting architectural decision, explores the existing codebase before writing the ADR, and produces a complete, correctly structured ADR with active-voice decision, prioritized drivers, split consequences, and no placeholder text.

checklist.name: Implementation Plan present
checklist.description: The ADR includes an ## Implementation Plan section (or equivalent heading) describing how the decision maps to code changes

checklist.name: Affected paths listed
checklist.description: The Implementation Plan section names at least one specific file path or directory from the codebase (e.g. src/middleware/auth.js or src/routes/) that will be affected

checklist.name: Decision in active voice
checklist.description: The Decision section uses active voice, beginning with 'We will' or an equivalent first-person plural construction

checklist.name: Status PROPOSED
checklist.description: The ADR has status: PROPOSED in its YAML frontmatter (not ACCEPTED, not DECIDED)

checklist.name: Authors field present
checklist.description: The ADR has an authors field in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: Date field present
checklist.description: The ADR has a date field in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: Correct sequential filename
checklist.description: The ADR filename begins with 0002 (zero-padded, next after the existing 0001 ADR), followed by a lowercase hyphenated slug

checklist.name: At least two alternatives
checklist.description: The Alternatives Considered section contains at least two distinct options

checklist.name: Alternatives have pros, cons, and rejection reason
checklist.description: Each alternative lists explicit pros, cons, and a reason it was rejected

checklist.name: Consequences split into three subsections
checklist.description: The Consequences section is divided into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections (all three must be present)

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: The ADR does not contain any placeholder text such as '[Driver 1]', '[Alternative 1]', 'TBD', or similar unfilled template markers
